g.text: Objective: decide whether the company can be measured at all, and if not, remove it from the universe with exactly one reason.
back to the screen board

text.tspan: its sector benchmark is looked up
industry = industry_damodaran, else the provider industry
(no industry_damodaran: the coverage gate drops it as industry_unmapped)

g.text: it has a sector benchmark with a weighted average cost of capital (WACC)

text.tspan: it leaves the universe with one reason
the first reason that applies, in this order:
benchmark_missing: no sector benchmark row, or one without a WACC
currency_uncovered: valuation currency (currency of the newest non-restated financials_annual row) missing, or not in config/currencies.yaml
every rule of the three layers runs

g.text: its market cap is in US dollars (USD), or empty
every quality gate passed
a quality gate failed
its rejected row is saved
damodaran_industry
config/currencies.yaml

text.tspan: a measured company with its sector benchmark (medians and WACC), or one rejected row with one reason

g.text: Architecture decision record (ADR): ADR 0006 (Implemented): a company that cannot be measured leaves the universe before any rule runs.
the screen finds the newest sector benchmark row [it has a weighted average cost of capital (WACC)]
the screen finds a sector benchmark row [its WACC is empty]
the screen finds no sector benchmark row [none for the industry and region]
the gate rejects it as industry unmapped [no Damodaran industry]
the gate rejects it as benchmark missing [no row, or no WACC]
the gate accepts its sector benchmark [a Damodaran industry and a WACC]
the gate rejects it as currency uncovered [its valuation currency has no rates]
the gate lets it in [its valuation currency has rates]
the seven quality gates pass
a quality gate fails [a figure misses its threshold, or is missing]
the run saves its rejected row
newest-year industry row
covered currencies
the measured company goes on to the quality gates [always: every measured company runs them]
